name: Particle ring
what: A ring of dots that turns, breaks into a cloud of stars drifting across the frame, then pulls back into the ring with a glow as it closes - a loading moment, a 'thinking' beat, a transition.

learned_from.what: a ring of dots scattering into stars and pulling back into a ring on black

motion: the ring appears around 12 f and turns the whole time; burst 16 f (slow end), drift 24 f, back 20 f (S-curve), glow 8 f, hold 16 f
